title: Snowburst Ring
summary: Dealing Cold damage creates Ice around the target.

fields.Snowburst: Once per attack, create an Ice surface in a 15 ft radius around affected targets when dealing qualifying Cold damage. It does not work with thrown weapons or certain delayed spell and retaliation damage.
fields.Ice: Difficult Terrain. A creature that slips falls Prone.
fields.Acquisition: Perception DC 10 to reveal a loose plank in the bedroom north of the Last Light Inn bar.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay details with pinned item and linked rules evidence.
